_comment: Declarative spec for tools/audit_visual_design.py — the game-wide visual
design audit. THIS FILE IS THE EXPANSION SURFACE: adding a surface, changing
a budget, or recording a complete owner-approved waiver is a JSON edit, not a
code edit. Adding a new KIND of check is a Python edit (see
Every budget below traces to a stable rule in the comprehensive design
language. The final 2026-08-09 owner decision makes the shipped game
Canvas-based 2D. Every active presentation is subject to the same builder
gate: the hash-bound canonical tools/audit_game_2d.py taxonomy classifies
every reachable executable spatial class/resource/model reference; any
proven 3D debt is an explicit failure and never satisfies acceptance. Runtime
claims, including touch sizes, require a same-process fresh probe response
to a cryptographically random one-use audit challenge. The audit snapshots
returned capture bytes into private memory and removes the temporary response
before checks run. Saved/manual facts remain diagnostic COVERAGE_GAP evidence

rules.texture_max_side_or_pot: DL-PERF-04: new textures are <=1024px longest side or power-of-two
rules.mural_layer_stack: DL-LAY-02: a panning promenade uses at least two independently instantiated, visibly rendered Canvas layers with distinct canonical decoded source pixels and distinct effective 64x36 viewport RGBA composites, verified contributing-visual draw order, meaningful effective-alpha viewport coverage, and measured differential movement; materials, groups, alternate viewports/cull masks, global modulation/Canvas lighting, or unsupported clipping/order remain a coverage gap until flattened evidence exists
rules.layering_rule: DL-LAY-01/DL-LAY-03/DL-LAY-04/DL-LAY-08: every active presentation has Canvas-only staging, named live Canvas draw-order roles, owned interaction cards, live_canvas_alpha_overlap_samples_v2 per-card occlusion over effective decoded painted alpha rather than rectangles, and sparse foreground; overlap requires alpha >=0.50, at least four painted samples, and >=5% of target painted area; source alpha is multiplied by effective Canvas opacity and Control clipping is honored, while materials/CanvasGroup/unsupported clipping, viewport, cull, or draw-order effects remain COVERAGE_GAP; the exact hash-bound tools/audit_game_2d.py taxonomy classifies every reachable active source dependency, model/resource load, dynamic ClassDB call, autoload, and scene transition, and every active closure member must be tracked at the bound HEAD so an ignored/untracked helper is a coverage gap rather than PASS; low-level spatial RenderingServer RID families fail, aliased/Callable/singleton calls are classified, and unresolved server calls gap; bound/Callable/escaped loaders plus UID/external/opaque/native executable resources remain a coverage gap rather than silently severing the source closure
rules.background_recessive: DL-READ-01/DL-READ-02: backgrounds frame play and interactive silhouettes remain identifiable in current, asymmetrically sampled visible/hidden state-local composites whose exact target difference agrees with independent_source_alpha_inverse_canvas_v1 projection from current source alpha, strict live Canvas metadata, bound instance paths, and an explicit implemented adapter that enters/asserts the named live state; duplicate/relabelled state captures do not establish coverage; source-image averages are risk triage only
rules.alpha_layer_budget: DL-PERF-03: transparent overdraw stays inside the Speedy-tier budget
rules.tap_target_size: DL-UI-03/DL-QA-07: required child-facing touch targets bind the exact live interaction registry node (never a highlight fallback), a resolver centre near source-alpha-painted visible art, and nine calls through the production hit resolver proving the target owns the centre plus eight 55px cardinal/diagonal boundary points (>=110px actual diameter); visible Canvas art is at least 64px in each dimension in the audited root viewport, proven by the same-process response to the audit's random one-use challenge and current provenance
rules.probe_gate: DL-QA-02/DL-QA-07: active shipped surfaces have fresh same-process automated evidence responding to a cryptographically random one-use challenge, snapshotted into private memory before its temporary output is consumed, and bound to exactly Godot 4.7.1-stable, Mobile, 1280x720 canvas_items/expand, the current clean whole Git worktree/HEAD/tree/source revision, the PASS-producing auditor and canonical 2D taxonomy hashes, and a project-wide path/hash manifest of runtime source candidates including ignored/custom-root code outside generated evidence roots; every reached active dependency must also be tracked at the bound HEAD; saved, replayed, missing, stale, dirty, ignored-active, untracked-active, external, UID, opaque, or unbound executable coverage never becomes pass
rules.licenses: DL-ASSET-04: every new asset gets an ASSET_LICENSES.md entry in the same commit
rules.no_text_in_art: DL-AGE-08/DL-READ-04: no scary imagery and no reading-dependent words, letters, or digits in world art
rules.standee_not_mural: DL-LAY-03: anything Roshan can tap, approach, pass, or stand behind is an independent owned card
rules.orphan_art: DL-PERF-06: superseded runtime art leaves export after references and provenance are resolved
rules.asset_generations: DL-ASSET-05: rejected generations and review material stay outside runtime assets
rules.waiver_contract: DL-QA-08: a waiver names exact scope, reason, owner, date, review trigger, and residual child risk
